weather.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 18 at 3:49PM MST until November 21 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
weather.text:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 2 and 7
inches with lower totals in the lower terrain near Heber City and
the higher totals across the higher terrain near Park City and the
Ogden Valley.

* WHERE...Wasatch Back.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Thursday to 5 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thursday evening and Friday morning
commutes.
weather.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For winter road conditions
from the Utah Department of Transportation, visit
http://www.udottraffic.utah.gov.

For graphical depictions of the snowfall forecast, including Official
NWS Forecast, High End Amount, and Low End Amount, visit
weather.gov/slc/winter.

weather.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 18 at 3:49PM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
weather.area: Wasatch Mountains I-80 North; Wasatch Mountains South of I-80; Western Uinta Mountains
weather.text:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 10 and 20
inches for the Wasatch Mountains with locally higher totals across
the upper Cottonwoods. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches for the Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Thursday to 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected.
